description: In 61 days, voters across Florida’s 21st District will decide what kind of future we are going to build. The primary is behind us. Now the real mission begins. This election is about whether we keep moving forward with cleaner water, safer communities, stronger support for veterans, lower taxes, secure borders, and an America First agenda – or hand the wheel back to the same tired politics that put Washington first.
